use_cases: Monthly revenue reporting by region and product category
business_questions: What was our revenue by region last quarter?
Which customers generate the most repeat revenue?

silver_verification.evidence: acme_retail_dev.silver.orders has declared PRIMARY KEY on (order_id, line_number), documented column comments on all 14 columns, standardized naming (snake_case business terms, no source-system prefixes), and no _rescued_data or ingest batch columns present.

grain.statement: One row per order line item.
grain.validation_evidence: order_total_usd and quantity are additive at the (order_id, line_number) grain; verified no double-counting by comparing SUM(order_total_usd) grouped at grain vs. header-level total on a 500-row sample.

source_to_target_mappings.transformation: CAST(total_amt AS DECIMAL(18,2)) -- source column is declared TEXT pending a source-system fix per its column comment; downstream consumers must cast, not assume it's already numeric.

dimensions.name: dim_customer
dimensions.grain: One row per customer per version (SCD type 2 on region).

attributes.name: region
attributes.scd_rationale: Business question requires attributing historical revenue to the region a customer was in AT THE TIME of the order, not their current region, per stated use case 'revenue by region last quarter'.

attributes.name: email
attributes.scd_rationale: Contact detail correction; no business requirement to preserve history, so overwrite in place.

assumptions.statement: Assumed 'revenue' in business questions means order_total_usd net of returns; silver.orders does not separate returns into a distinct table.
assumptions.basis: No returns table found in silver schema; flagged for human confirmation before this measure is treated as authoritative for finance reporting.
